scope: Controlled predictor/normalizer/history audit and frozen replication on two previously unseen sequence groups; no formal H1/H2/H3 or hardware claim
selection: Distinct unused Zurich group02 and04, names fixed before HEAD requests and model outputs. Keep both regardless of detector or selector performance; no pristine official-test claim
roll_rule: Causal EMA state rolled by floor(height/3),floor(width/3) at each scale, channels unchanged
global_rule: Per-channel spatial mean of prior EMA state broadcast to all sites, no current spatial features in prediction
absolute: mean_channel(abs(H-P)); zero predictor identical to current_activity
current: sum_channel(abs(H-P))/(sum_channel(abs(H))+1e-8), exact original canonical baseline formula; zero/current degenerates toward unit scores at active sites and is labeled accordingly
precision: C-contiguous float32 descriptors, states and channel reductions; deterministic index tie-breaking
confidence_source: Frozen thun all-open calibration from allocation_validity_v01; no new-sequence tuning or per-variant retuning in this study
primary_contrasts: ema/current versus ema/absolute: denominator at fixed predictor
ema/current versus ema_lag3/current and ema_roll/current: historical alignment at fixed normalizer
ema/current versus ema_activity and current_activity: residual versus activity alone
predictor MAE rank versus allocation-retention rank within each frozen normalizer
metrics: Shared dense-matched GT/frame preservation with lost/gained IDs, full-GT recall and FPPI; track-equal loss and dense coverage; zero-current-descriptor selected fraction is a diagnostic, not proof of wasted computation because smoothing reads3x3 neighbors
limitations: Two new sequence groups and one checkpoint cannot establish broad population significance
All old sequences development-exposed; new sequences used once under frozen choices, no external preregistration
Offline anchor admission before NMS, all underlying detector computation performed
Feature prediction MAE alone cannot identify an allocation mechanism
No importance/hybrid correction or selected-backend numerical certification
